newsitem.title: UK: GUS rebounds amid weekend press comment.
newsitem.headline: GUS rebounds amid weekend press comment.

text.p: Shares in home shopping group Great Universal Stores were helped by positive weekend press comment on Monday, following a sharp fall in the group's profits which prompted analysts to downgrade forecasts last week.
The shares gained 12p to 637-1/2p by 0949 GMT after losing around 25p in the two sessions after the company's half-year results last week.

The Observer newspaper said on Sunday that GUS would probably face regulatory hurdles to buying the Freemans home shopping business from Sears Plc, but it could still benefit even if one of its rivals snaps up Freemans.
GUS said last week it would be interested in buying the Freemans catalogue business owned by Sears Plc but feared regulatory hurdles.
GUS also said its home shopping division could be improved, after reporting its first fall in profits for 48 years.
The newspaper commented that the shares could offer long-term value if the home-shopping business could be turned around.
